name: 40-nichi 40-ya no Ame
source:
In 40 Days and 40 Nights of Rain, two people met.
This is the tale of the girl with sky-blue eyes and the tin plate soldier.

[From [url=http://www.grey-space.net/starchanchan/vn/projects-40days.html]Deja Vu[/url]]
translation:
在四十天、四十夜的雨中，两个人相遇了。
这是一个关于天蓝色眼眸的少女与锡兵的故事。

[摘自[url=http://www.grey-space.net/starchanchan/vn/projects-40days.html]Deja Vu[/url]]
